entries.label: CO  66  Aquadynamis Feet Special

tags.subject: tall tribal flourishes with curl-tails
tags.placement: outer side of both ankles and along the top of the foot

entries.description: A pair of mirrored vertical tribal flourishes: a sharp spearhead-and-curl at the outer ankle and a longer trailing curl-tail running across the top of the foot. The shapes flow like brushed cursive in a stylised aquatic script.

entries.label: CO  51  Nexregiant Feet Female

tags.subject: filled tribal foot-armour
tags.placement: top of both feet, ankles, and lower calf

entries.description: Heavy mirrored tribal fills sheath the top of each foot and wrap up around the ankle into a thick cuff that climbs onto the lower calf. Curling negative-space slits and small dragon-head flourishes break up an otherwise near-solid mass of ink.

entries.label: CO  52  Faedis Feet Female

tags.subject: solid ink stockings
tags.style: dense blotted ink with soft gradient top edge
tags.placement: full top of both feet, soles, ankles, and lower-to-mid leg

entries.description: A full blackout fill covering the entire foot — top, sole, and toes — that continues up the ankle and lower leg as a tall stocking. The upper edge feathers into a soft gradient, reading like thigh-high opera stockings dyed straight into the skin.

entries.label: CO  54  Do'Tive Feet Base Female

tags.subject: dotted contour outlines
tags.placement: ankle, top of foot, and along the outer edge of the foot

entries.description: Long, looping chains of small dots trace soft contour lines across the top of the foot and around the ankle, with extra arcs at the outer edge near the little toe. The whole design reads as a stippled body-contour map rather than any single object.

entries.label: CO  54  Do'Tive Feet Tertiary Female

tags.subject: scrollwork dotted contours with rosette accents
tags.placement: ankle, top of foot, and outer edge of the foot

entries.description: A denser variant of the dotted contour layout, with the looping outlines thickened into beaded scrollwork and small rosette curls added at the ankle and the outer foot edge. The motif still reads as fine stippled ornament rather than a solid form.

entries.id: CO 56 Smoke Bones Feet Base Female
entries.label: CO  56  Smoke Bones Feet Base Female

tags.subject: skeletal foot x-ray
tags.placement: top of both feet, toes, ankles, and lower leg

entries.description: A clean skeletal anatomy laid over each foot, with metatarsal and phalange bones running from the ankle out to every toe-tip and the tibia/fibula pair visible up the lower leg. The ankle joint is rendered like an x-ray plate.

entries.id: CO 56 Smoke Bones Feet Tribal L1 Female
entries.label: CO  56  Smoke Bones Feet Tribal L 1  Female

tags.subject: scattered tribal sun-and-bone motifs
tags.placement: top of both feet, ankles, and lower leg

entries.description: A mix of tribal accents: a small spoked sun-disc near the toe-base, short rib-bar clusters across the top of the foot, and longer ladder-and-curl shapes climbing the ankle and lower leg. The motifs sit loose rather than as one continuous piece.

entries.id: CO 56 Smoke Bones Feet Tribal L2 Female
entries.label: CO  56  Smoke Bones Feet Tribal L 2  Female

tags.subject: sparse tribal sparks and bars
tags.placement: top of both feet, ankles, and lower leg

entries.description: A loose pattern of tiny curl-hooks, short horizontal bars and dotted accents scattered across the top of the foot, the ankle, and up the lower leg. Nothing fills the design — it reads as drifting flecks of ink.

entries.label: CO  57  Egyptaris Feet Female

tags.subject: etched tribal foot armour with central eye
tags.placement: top of both feet, ankles, and lower leg

entries.description: A linework armour-wrap that traces the top of each foot with curling tendrils and stylised feather shapes, anchored by a large central eye-and-disc motif sitting between the ankles. Banded segments run up the lower leg with small ankh-like glyphs.

entries.label: CO  62  Blood Curse Feet Female

tags.subject: branching vein cracks
tags.placement: scattered across top of both feet, ankles, and lower leg

entries.description: A spread of thin, fractal capillary lines that branch like burst blood vessels or roots crawling over the top of each foot and up the ankle. There is no symmetry or central shape, only creeping, curse-like veins under the skin.

entries.label: CO  65  Flora Iter Foot Female

tags.subject: tribal henna-style foot-piece
tags.placement: top of the left foot, ankle, and lower leg

entries.description: A single-foot design only — an ornate filigree of curls, eyes and chevrons fills the top of the left foot and wraps the ankle, with a row of triangular tooth-shapes running along the top edge. A second banded cuff sits on the lower leg.

entries.label: CO  68  Brimflame Foot Female

tags.subject: spear-and-flame tribal cap
tags.style: bold tribal with jagged flame edges
tags.placement: top of both feet, ankles, and a band on the lower leg

entries.description: Heavy mirrored tribal fills with jagged, fire-like outer edges cover the top of each foot and the ankle, with a separate dense flame-cap wrapping the lower leg above. The interior is broken by curling negative-space lines that give it a banded-flame texture.
